profile.en: She is a young Yatagarasu girl who lives with Yukikaze - her grown-up form after something happened in the future. She is also Minasaki's sister, and although she used to have a crow-like head, she has become more human-like as an adult.

text.ja: 海辺のつよつよヤタガラス、ハツカゼ参上！　ほらほらどうよどうよ？　私の大人水着でふうまなんてイチコロなのさー、むふー！
text.en: I'm Hatsukaze, the strongest Yatagarasu by the sea! How's this, how's this? My adult swimsuit is the best, and I'm not just saying that because I'm a Fuuma - muhu!

text.ja: 水着の霊鳥ハツカゼとは私のことだ！　どんな勝負でも受けて立つぞー！
text.en: I'm Hatsukaze, the spirit bird in a swimsuit! I'll take on any challenge you've got!

text.ja: 私の大人水着にメロメロになったでしょ？　さあさあ見物料を払ってもらおうじゃないか！
text.en: You're drooling over my adult swimsuit, aren't you? Well, pay up if you want to keep looking!

text.ja: ふっふっふーっ！　私と勝負なんていい度胸だね！　大人になったつよつよヤタガラスの力を思い知らせてやるー！
text.en: Huh-huh-huh, you've got some nerve challenging me! I'll show you the power of a grown-up Yatagarasu!

text.ja: このカラス浮き輪がある限り私は溺れない！　海辺でも最強なんだー！　むふーッ！
text.en: As long as I've got this crow floatie, I won't drown! I'm the strongest, even by the sea - muhu!

text.ja: 海と言ったら遊びもいいけどバーベキューもねっ！　焼肉！　ソーセージ！　ハンバーグ！　焼き鳥ー！　共食いも上等だーい！
text.en: The beach is great for playing, but it's also perfect for a barbecue! Grilled meat, sausages, hamburgers, and skewers - I'll take them all!

text.ja: 海だー！　泳ご泳ごッ！　えっ？　烏の行水って何？　新作の和菓子か何か？　奢って奢ってー！　私にお菓子を貢ぐといいことあるよー！
text.en: It's the beach! Let's swim! What's "crow's water"? Is it a new Japanese snack? Treat me to some, and I might just reward you!

text.ja: ビーチフラッグにビーチバレー、ビーチパラソルでもなんでもかかってきんしゃい！　カモーン！　よゆーで私が全勝利だからなー！
text.en: Bring it on - beach flags, beach volleyball, or beach parasols! I'll take them all on and win, of course!

text.ja: 「ふふんっ、な、何されても感じないってば……！　ひひゃあッ！？　オマンコはダメっ、んんあっ、そこは感じるとこひイイイっ！？」
text.en: "Huh, I won't feel a thing...! Hiyah! Oh no, my pussy's sensitive...! Ahhh, it feels so good!"

text.ja: 「わっ、私の勝ちだね……！　そんな必死に腰動かして……私にメロメロになって……んいいいっ、イクイクイクぅうッ！！」
text.en: "I win, of course...! You're moving your hips so desperately... and you're so obsessed with me...! Ahhh, I'm cumming, cumming, cumming!"
